comment: IMU axes -> simulation body frame (+X fore, +Y left, +Z up)
provenance: Mean of two scripts.imu_calib runs, then rotated 180 deg about Z. The two runs agreed to 1.11 deg and sat 4.6 deg off axis-alignment in the same direction, so that tilt is a real mounting offset and was kept. The 180 deg turn corrects a fore/aft mix-up during posing: the model's +X points AWAY from the screen (m5stack.stl sits at CAD Z -37.5..-21, and CAD Z is sim X), so 'nose down' meant screen up. Getting front and back swapped swaps left and right with it, which is why the third-pose cross check still passed. Symptom was pitch and roll both inverted in scripts.mirror while level looked correct.
